ITEM.PTXT: During acceleration, when cut signal 1 (during starting acceleration) or cut signal 2 (during passing acceleration) is input from the engine control computer to the air conditioning computer, the air conditioning computer reduces the compressor operating capacity output as shown in the illustration, reducing the fuel injection volume during acceleration and improving acceleration performance. The amount by which the compressor operating capacity output is reduced is varied according to the cooling load so that no difference in perceived temperature is felt.
